assumptions: Fixed known B0, explicit uniform susceptibility or Cartesian J; same verified terrain/operator domain
Exact norm(B0+B)-norm(B0) after vector superposition; rationalised difference preserves tiny anomalies
Positive explicit field norm floor rejects zero-field nondifferentiability at every evaluated model
No weak-field cap on exact magnitude; linear prediction/residuals are separate diagnostics
Explicit initial values and supplied independent sigma; positive L2 reference/edges/scales
Analytic matrix-free Jacobian; local augmented GaussNewton condition upper bound, not exact Hessian
Stationarity alone establishes neither local/global optimum nor unique geology; compare starts and residuals
Shared finite operator/call/kernel budgets; atomic failures; Python3.12+ pinned scalable execution
Single-parameter nonlinear fits use bounded TRF with one explicit Jacobian column; larger fits use matrix-free TRF/LSMR. No dense sensitivity G.
